contenders.handicapper_notes: Top selection who produced an eye-catching late burst when third over 1000m at Northam last week, finishing ahead of Incredible Mr Fox. Key beneficiary of the draw, landing barrier 1 which provides a massive tactical boost over the 1000m sprint chute at Belmont. Solid 65 speed rating two back confirms he is ready to peak fourth-up.
